es.title: Noticias de Copyright e Inteligencia Artificial
es.subtitle: Notas publicadas por medios reales de la industria, con liga al artículo original. Sin noticias inventadas.

items.title: Suno argues that judge should throw out musician’s publicity rights lawsuit
items.summary: Suno is fighting several music industry lawsuits, but one stands out - filed by musician Jason Isbell - because it accuses the AI company of infringing publicity rights by connecting artist names to musical styles in the back-end. Suno has responded to that lawsuit, urging the judge to dismiss it

items.title: Meta Employees ‘Interacted’ With Pirated Copies of Adult Films, Filing Shows
items.summary: A newly unredacted court filing shows that Meta’s internal investigation found several employees who appear to have interacted with Strike 3’s adult films. The adult content producers say these were torrented copies listed in their lawsuit, but Meta says there is no evidence of torrenting. The company also stresses tha…

items.title: Music industry intervenes in Open AI’s big legal battle with newspapers and authors
items.summary: All of the US music industry’s copyright lawsuits against AI companies swing on whether or not AI training is fair use under US law. A big legal battle involving authors, newspapers and Open AI also centres on fair use, and the music industry has now intervened in that case via an amicus brief

items.title: Nothing Illegal Here: Suno Moves to Dismiss Jason Isbell’s Class Action Lawsuit on First Amendment and US Copyright Law Grounds
items.summary: Suno moves to dismiss a right-of-publicity case filed by a group of performers, including Jason Isbell and David Lowery, claiming that none of its outputs could be mistaken for those musicians. Suno has filed a motion to dismiss the U.S. privacy and publicity rights claims filed by musicians Jason Isbell and David Lowe…

items.title: Suno Fires Back Against Apple’s Subpoena Opposition, Doubling Down on Its Push for Information About ‘Current License Negotiations,’ ‘Anti-AI Deal Terms,’ and More
items.summary: Suno is doubling down on its Apple subpoena push, arguing that the information being sought – about Apple Music’s major label licensing talks, “anti-AI deal terms,” and more – is central to its fair use and copyright misuse arguments. The AI music platform took aim at Apple’s motion to quash in a 24-page opposition fil…

items.title: As UMG v. Suno Subpoenas Target the MLC, Multiple Investors, DistroKid, and Now Apple Music, Are Game-Changing Disclosures on the Horizon?
items.summary: As Suno fends off an ever-growing number of music industry copyright complaints, a raft of subpoena showdowns – including the AI platform’s own document and deposition demands – are now in full swing. Does that mean game-changing disclosures are on the horizon? Time will tell, though the current evidence suggests yes.…

items.title: BTS ‘SWIM’ copyright lawsuit against HYBE dropped by songwriters less than four months after filing
items.summary: Dismissal comes less than four months after the songwriters filed their complaint on July 8 Source

items.title: B2B music streamer Soundtrack inks SESAC deal, estimates unlicensed music in US businesses costs the industry $1.4B a year
items.summary: Soundtrack now licensed by all four major US PROs Source

items.title: Apple Music set for karaoke expansion with ‘Selfie Sing’ feature
items.summary: Spotify may be preparing to launch a tool for people to remix songs using AI, but Apple Music’s next feature is more about making songs your own… with your voice. It’s called ‘Selfie Sing’. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Suno lleva su generador de canciones a ChatGPT y Claude
items.summary: Suno MCP, en beta desde el 28 de octubre, permite crear canciones desde ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini o Cursor, incluso con el plan gratuito y sus créditos.

items.title: Spotify quiere ser el agente musical de ChatGPT y Claude
items.summary: Spotify quiere ser el servicio que eligen los agentes de IA: ya está en ChatGPT, Claude y Muse, y asegura que no comparte datos de escucha con ellos.

items.title: 5 things to know about CISAC’s global report, as songwriter royalty collections hit record $15.9B in 2025, with $900M+ from The MLC, and AI in focus
items.summary: Global songwriter royalty collections hit a record €14.06 billion in 2025, with the increase largely driven by the first-time inclusion of The MLC Source

tip.title: Guarda los proyectos, no solo el master
tip.body: En una disputa de autoría, el archivo de sesión de tu DAW con fecha, stems y versiones intermedias pesa más que el WAV final. Respalda el proyecto completo, no nada más el bounce.

tip.title: Keep the project files, not just the master
tip.body: In an authorship dispute, your dated DAW session with stems and work-in-progress versions carries more weight than the final WAV. Back up the whole project, not just the bounce.
